title: Best single buy and later sell
summary: From a diary of daily mango prices, find the most you could earn by buying once and selling on a later day.
goal: Find the largest profit from one buy and one later sell

examples.label: Six mornings
examples.explanation: Buy at 1 on day 1, sell at 6 on day 4.

examples.label: Prices only fall
examples.explanation: Every sale would lose money, so the best choice is not to trade.

examples.label: A late dip
examples.explanation: Buy at 2, sell at 4. The cheaper day 2 comes too late to sell afterwards.

ladder.name: Try every buy and sell day
ladder.idea: For every buying day, try every later selling day and keep the best profit.

ladder.name: Remember the cheapest morning
ladder.idea: Walk through the days once. Keep the cheapest price so far; each day, check what selling today would earn.
ladder.insight: For a sale on any given day, the best buying day is simply the cheapest earlier day. One remembered number replaces the inner loop.

approaches.name: Remember the cheapest morning
approaches.summary: Track the cheapest price so far and the best profit from selling today.

transfer.problem: A hiker records altitude every hour. Find the biggest climb from a lower point to a later higher point.
transfer.explanation: It is the same shape: remember the lowest altitude so far, and at each hour compare the climb from that lowest point.

selfCheck: Updates the cheapest price before or instead of selling on that day.
Uses one pass over the prices.

aka: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
